newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ROKISHKIS 5MO PROFIT UP, 1997 SEEN 17 MLN LTL.
newsitem.headline: ROKISHKIS 5MO PROFIT UP, 1997 SEEN 17 MLN LTL.

text.p: Lithuania's Rokishkis Cheese on Friday said its net profit after five months rose to 7.15 million litas from 1.45 million litas in the same period last year.
The company also told Reuters that it expected a net profit of 17 million litas in the whole of 1997.
"We succeeded to increase our production this year and had some products in reserves which were produced the last year," chief financial executive Valerija Shimeniene told Reuters.
"Our net profit in May rose to 1.47 million litas compared to 1.385 million litas in April," Shimeniene added.
"The company targets a net profit of 17-18 million litas litas at the end of this year compared to 10.463 million litas audited net profit in 1996," Shimeniene said.
The company reported earlier that its sales for the five months of the year advanced to 55.8 million litas compared to 30.3 million litas in the same period last year.
Shimeniene also said that the company dominated 28 percent of the local dairy products market in May.
"The company is considering reducing prices for some products sold on the local market from June 16 and to increase its turnover and the share of the market," Shimeniene said.
